description: This file defines an abstract base class for custom secret manager integrations within the LiteLLM framework. It provides method signatures for reading, writing, deleting secrets, and performing health checks, with detailed docstrings and example usage. It serves as a template for developers to implement their own secret managers.

classes.name: CustomSecretManager
classes.description: An abstract base class for implementing custom secret managers in LiteLLM, providing method signatures for secret operations and environment validation.

methods.name: Optional[str] async_read_secret( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously read a secret from the custom secret manager.

methods.name: Optional[str] sync_read_secret( self, secret_name: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Abstract method to synchronously read a secret from the custom secret manager.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] async_write_secret( self, secret_name: str, secret_value: str, description: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, tags: Optional[Union[dict, list]] = None, )
methods.description: Optional method for asynchronously writing a secret; NotImplementedError by default.

methods.name: dict async_delete_secret( self, secret_name: str, recovery_window_in_days: Optional[int] = 7, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
methods.description: Optional method for asynchronously deleting a secret; NotImplementedError by default.

methods.name: bool validate_environment(self)
methods.description: Method to validate environment/configuration for the secret manager; defaults to always returning True.

methods.name: bool async_health_check( self, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None )
methods.description: Optional async method to perform health check; defaults to returning True.

methods.name: str __repr__(self)
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the secret manager instance.
